findings.message: This assertion calls comparisonToJson twice and compares the two results, so it always passes even if the export shape changes. It repeats the exact pattern already fixed for inspectionToJson in stage 2. Use a fixed expected document or assert individual stable fields (schema, saved, nested times) instead.

chartIssues deliberately emits line 0 for chart-level problems (missing grid/wind, file too large), but this formatter renders them with `issue.line || "?"`, so they appear as 'line ?: Chart needs a grid line' instead of a chart-level label. Reproduced: chartIssues('TRIREME-CHART v1\nwind 0 0\n') yields {line:0}, formatted as 'line ?: ...'. The sibling formatIssuesForClipboard already maps line 0

parse() reports directive errors one line too high: `number = index + 2` where `index` is the 0-based enumerate index over all lines. With no leading comments the first directive is on line 2 but is reported as line 3; with one leading comment it is on line 3 but reported as line 4. Reproduced with `trireme chart` on a chart whose second line is `bogus 1 2`. The authoritative chart::issues validat
